label: Low Endurance
description: Tires quickly in prolonged fights.
gameplayEffect: Stamina drains 25% faster in battle.

label: Reduced Mobility
description: Slow movement speed or an old injury limits movement.
gameplayEffect: Speed reduced by 8 in combat calculations.

label: Low Chakra Reserves
description: Small chakra pool limits technique use.
gameplayEffect: Maximum chakra reduced by 15 points.

label: Inefficient Chakra Control
description: Techniques cost more chakra than normal.
gameplayEffect: Technique chakra costs increased by 20%.

label: Poor Focus Under Pressure
description: Makes mistakes when the battle intensifies.
gameplayEffect: Hit accuracy drops 10% when below 30% health.

label: Tunnel Vision
description: Fixates on one target and ignores surrounding threats.
gameplayEffect: Vulnerable to flanking; cannot switch targets easily.

label: Anger
description: Provoked easily, leading to reckless decisions.
gameplayEffect: Defense drops when taunted or insulted in battle log.

label: Guilt
description: Haunted by past failures or losses.
gameplayEffect: Hesitates before finishing a weakened opponent.

label: Attachment
description: Protective of a person or thing that can be exploited.
gameplayEffect: Opponent can feign threatening the attachment to force surrender.

label: Fear
description: A specific phobia can be triggered mid-battle.
gameplayEffect: Freezes for one turn when the feared condition appears.

label: Predictable Patterns
description: Repeats the same openings, easy to read.
gameplayEffect: Opponent gains +5 accuracy against this character.

label: Poor Adaptability
description: Struggles when the battle plan fails.
gameplayEffect: Action selection becomes less effective after turn 4.

label: Environmental Weakness
description: Performs poorly in certain terrain or conditions.
gameplayEffect: Stats reduced by 5 in unfavorable terrain.

label: Setup Time
description: Strong techniques require multiple turns to prepare.
gameplayEffect: Special attacks take +1 extra turn to charge.

label: Range Restriction
description: Best techniques only work at a fixed distance.
gameplayEffect: Cannot use special attacks outside preferred range.

label: Recoil
description: Powerful techniques damage the user as well.
gameplayEffect: Special attacks deal 10% of damage back to user.

label: Long Cooldown
description: Strong techniques cannot be used often.
gameplayEffect: Special attack cooldown increased by 1 turn.

label: Sensory Limitation
description: Limited detection or vulnerable to deception.
gameplayEffect: Higher chance to be hit by genjutsu or ambush.

label: Trust Issues
description: Hard to accept help or coordinate with allies.
gameplayEffect: Support actions from allies are 10% less effective.

label: Duty Conflict
description: Conflicting loyalties can paralyze decisions.
gameplayEffect: May skip a turn when torn between two objectives.

label: Reputation
description: A well-known name draws unwanted attention.
gameplayEffect: Enemies prioritize targeting this character.

label: OC-specific Weakness
description: Original weakness tied to custom lore.
gameplayEffect: Defined by the OC's custom backstory.
